ambient: The floor takes your weight, and keeps taking it.
A sound arrives in one solid slab and stops.
Something crosses the plateau a long way off, at your speed.
description: A wide flat place with a low ceiling, lit evenly by nothing in particular. You are very heavy here. Everything you decide to do happens a moment after you decide it, and the gap has stopped bothering you.
name: The Plateau

looks: Half a second, consistently, between deciding and doing.
You test it. The test finishes before you remember starting.
objects.name: the gap

looks: Reporting in from a considerable distance. All well.
They are managing without you and doing a decent job.
objects.name: your legs

weather: The air is heavy and even and does not move. Weather would have to be arranged, and nobody has.
